extracted.name: Curried mango & chickpea pot
extracted.description: Make this spiced mango, red cabbage, spinach and chickpea salad as a speedy packed lunch for one. It's not only tasty, but healthy too, delivering three of your 5-a-day
ingredient_lines: ½ small red chilli finely sliced (deseeded if you want less heat)
instruction_lines: Combine the chickpeas, yogurt, lemon and korma paste in a bowl, then toss with the carrot, cabbage, spinach and mango. Tip into your lunchbox or an airtight container and scatter with the nigella seeds and red chilli.
